math_review.definitions:
Exact 8-stage raw-U Rosenbrock-Wanner equations for autonomous ODEs y' = f(y):
  W U_i = H_i(U_{<i}), where W = I - tau J_n, tau = h * gamma > 0, J_n = Df(y_n)
  H_i(U_{<i}) = tau * f(y_n + sum_{j<i} A_{ij} U_j) + gamma * sum_{j<i} C_{ij} U_j for i = 0..7
Non-autonomous extension includes time derivative term: + h * gamma_i * f_t(t_n, y_n).
Stage residual for candidate vector U_hat: r_i = W U_hat_i - H_i(U_hat_{<i}).
Sequential solution yields r_i = 0 within machine roundoff for all 8 stages.
Physical visible state: (t_n, y_n). Hidden controller state: S_{controller} = (h_{proposed}, e_{prev}, controller_kind, fresh_state, counters).
Session identity tuple: I = (method, dimension, model_epoch, provider_epoch, norm_epoch, tolerance_epoch).
assumptions: W = I - h gamma J_n is nonsingular and row-diagonally dominant M-matrix on admissible ODE domain.
The ODE vector field f is deterministic for fixed time, owner, and epoch.
Tableau matrices A and C are strictly lower-triangular (A_{ij} = C_{ij} = 0 for j >= i), establishing finite causal dependency depth s = 8.
math_review.derivation: By strict lower-triangularity of A and C, stage U_0 depends only on f(y_n) and W^{-1}. Stage U_i depends exclusively on earlier stages U_0, ..., U_{i-1}. In exact arithmetic, any simultaneous block iteration U^{(q+1)} = W^{-1} H(U^{(q)}) terminates in at most 8 sweeps with exact solution. In the persistent session driver, sequential LU factorization solves each stage exactly in 1 pass. A paused session (SessionAdvance::Yield) freezes accepted state (t, y) and retains controller state S_{controller} and work counters W. Resuming continuation with identical identity I preserves exact bit-level trajectory as uninterrupted integration, whereas visible-state restart loses S_{controller}, resetting initial step size h0, discarding FSAL/cached LU, and perturbing adaptive step sequence.
math_review.roundoff_model: IEEE 754 double precision (binary64) arithmetic. Error control uses WRMS norm over components scaled by atol + rtol * max(|y|, |y_{new}|). Bit-identity comparisons verified via f64::to_bits(). Zero-allocation verified via thread-local Counted allocator auditing hot loops.
